messages:
Morgan: Pushed a second round of UI tweaks for the Embeddings & Rerank panel. Main changes: compact batch uploader, vector preview tooltip, and new relevance table column for 'export status'. Link: https://figma.com/file/XYZ-emb-rerank-v2 :eyes:

Eli: Nice. Compact uploader looks much cleaner for small jobs. Question: where does the sample size selector live now? I think it should be next to the "Start rerank" CTA, not buried in the modal footer.

Ana: Agree with Eli. Also, the tooltip for vector preview is neat but it overlaps the table header when narrow. Need a responsive placement. Maybe switch to anchored bottom popover on small widths.

Sana: Accessibility quick note: the tooltip must be focusable and dismissible with Esc. Also ensure it uses role="dialog" when opened via keyboard. Color contrast for the tooltip body is borderline on dark mode.

DevBot: Reminder: Last deployment added a server-side cap on CSV uploads at 10,000 rows. Returns 413 for larger files.

Ravi: FYI from infra: exporting raw vectors for 5k+ rows can spike disk and memory on the worker. We should stream gzipped NDJSON and chunk the conversion so it doesn't OOM.

Morgan: Good catch. Let's add a file size warning in the export modal and auto-select NDJSON+gzip for >1k. Priya (copy) can you draft wording?

Eli: Also propose an inline sample count estimator: show estimated exported size (MB) based on model vector dims and sample size. Helps set expectations.

Ana: For relevance table, suggestion: add a small filter chip row to toggle showing "approximate" results only, so reviewers can focus on completed exact ranks.

Sana: Also request: keyboard order in the uploader modal is broken when you tab through the mapping dropdowns. Repro steps saved in a gist: https://gist.github.com/sana/emb-uploader-a11y.

Morgan: Action items: - Ana to propose responsive behavior for vector tooltip - Eli to move sample size selector near CTA in mock - Sana to finalize a11y checklist + gist link - Ravi to document streaming NDJSON behavior + limits - Priya to write export warnings + size estimator copy - Morgan to update fig and follow up with eng on 413 limit.

Priya: Export warning draft: "Raw vector downloads can be large. For jobs over 1,000 items we recommend NDJSON (gzipped) to reduce download size. Download may take time and incur charges." Thoughts?

Eli: Suggest tightening: "Large downloads may be slow and incur charges. For >1,000 items, we use gzipped NDJSON by default."

Sana: +1. Also include accessible confirmation before starting. A dialog: "This download may be large. Continue?" with focus on the primary action.

Ravi: I'll add server-side streaming with a progress endpoint. ETA 2 days. Will also add a header X-Export-Size-Estimate if possible.

Morgan: OK shipping plan: finalize copy and a11y checks today, engineering to land streaming export next sprint, design to deliver final frames. We'll do a quick regression with NVDA after export lands.

DevBot: Task updated <#design-board-456> status -> in progress. Assigned: Ana, Eli, Priya, Ravi, Sana. Due: 3 days.
